question: Two projects are named tunelo: egress/tunelo is mehdieidi/tunelo (a Go WireGuard-over-websocket wrapper) and the new tunelo-net records are jiweiyuan/tunelo (a Rust QUIC HTTP tunnel with a public relay at tunelo.net). Should the entity resolver keep them as separate vendors?
why: the provider name is the same word; the repositories, languages and offers differ.
